items.title: Taiwan Endures Greater Cyber Pressure From China
items.description: Chinese cyberattacks on Taiwan's critical infrastructure — including energy utilities and hospitals — rose 6% in 2025, averaging 2.63 million attacks a day.

items.title: CISO Succession Crisis Highlights How Turnover Amplifies Security Risks
items.description: When cybersecurity leadership turns over too fast, risk does not reset. It compounds.
